title: Receipt signature computed over the payload only, not the frame -> SIG_INVALID

source.model: S-P1 Q4 companion B (frame fields outside the signature), degraded

scenario: An issuer (or verifier) that binds only the payload lets the frame header be changed under a valid signature.

mutations.value: service kms signature over the JCS payload bytes only

test_universe.hooks: sign hook: S_kms = sign(payload) instead of sign(F_kms); adversarial=True

notes: Issuer face: the service must sign the full ENC frame; a live check is to verify the service's S over F_kms.

needs: A signature by the service kms key over chosen bytes: TEST issuer or staging hook only.

subcases.construction: TEST issue, adversarial; sign hook: S_kms = kms signature over the JCS payload only (not the frame); A_sig stamped
subcases.T_derivation: T = nTime(h*) of the fixture's own receipt proof and headers (a_sig and receipt_anchor as stamped; rows 11.1-11.4 pass); U = 7200 + max nTime(h*..h*+5) (A10.1.1)
